title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - ContactLineSystem
description: Contact Line System (era:ContactLineSystem's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): System that is used to transmit electrical energy to road or rail vehicles.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ContactLineSystem'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

conditionalRegenerativeBrake.description: Property. Indication whether regenerative braking is permitted, not permitted, or permitted under specific conditions. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.4) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Regenerative Braking' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/regenerative-braking/RegenerativeBraking), 5 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

conditionsAppliedRegenerativeBraking.description: Relationship. Name and/or reference of the document specifying the conditions applying in regards to regenerative braking. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.4.1)

contactLineSystemType.description: Property. Indication of the type of the contact line system. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.1.1) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Contact Line Systems' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/contact-line-systems/ContactLineSystems), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

currentLimitationRequired.description: Property. Indication of whether an on board current or power limitation function on vehicles is required. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.5.1)

energySupplySystem.description: Property. Indication of the traction supply system (nominal voltage and frequency). (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.1.2) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Energy Supply Systems' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/energy-supply-systems/EnergySupplySystems), 19 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

maxCurrentStandstillPantograph.description: Property. Indication of the maximum allowable train current at standstill expressed in amperes. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.3, 1.2.2.0.6.1)

maxTrainCurrent.description: Property. Indication of the maximum allowable train current expressed in amperes. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.2)

maximumContactWireHeight.description: Property. Indication of the maximum contact wire height expressed in metres. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.5)

minimumContactWireHeight.description: Property. Indication of the minimum contact wire height expressed in metres. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.6)

umax2.description: Property. Highest non-permanent voltage (Umax2) for France on lines not compliant with values defined in the EN50163:2004+A1:2007+A2:2020+A3:2022 (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.2.2.1.3)
